description: This file implements an in-memory B-Tree data structure with generic type support, including node management, insertion, deletion, iteration, and copy-on-write semantics, used within the Kubernetes utils package.

classes.name: FreeList
classes.description: A thread-safe free list for managing reusable nodes in the B-Tree.

classes.name: node
classes.description: Internal node structure for the B-Tree, holding items and child nodes.

classes.name: BTree
classes.description: A generic, in-memory B-Tree implementation supporting ordered data storage and retrieval.

classes.name: copyOnWriteContext
classes.description: Context managing node ownership and copy-on-write semantics for thread-safe modifications.

classes.name: optionalItem
classes.description: Helper struct for optional range boundaries during iteration.

methods.name: NewFreeList
methods.description: Creates a new thread-safe free list for nodes.

methods.name: newNode
methods.description: Allocates a new node, either from the free list or by creating a new one.

methods.name: freeNode
methods.description: Returns a node to the free list if owned by the current context.

methods.name: insertAt
methods.description: Inserts an item at a specific index within a node's item slice.

methods.name: removeAt
methods.description: Removes an item at a specific index within a node's item slice.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes and returns the last item in a node's item slice.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Truncates the node's item slice at a specified index.

methods.name: find
methods.description: Finds the index where an item should be inserted or exists within a sorted list.

methods.name: mutableFor
methods.description: Returns a mutable copy of a node for a given copy-on-write context.

methods.name: mutableChild
methods.description: Returns a mutable version of a child node at a given index.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a node at a specified index into two nodes.

methods.name: maybeSplitChild
methods.description: Splits a child node if it exceeds max items.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts an item into the subtree rooted at this node, maintaining max items per node.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a specific key from the subtree.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Finds the minimum item in a subtree.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Finds the maximum item in a subtree.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item or min/max from the subtree.

methods.name: growChildAndRemove
methods.description: Ensures a child node has enough items before removal, handling merging or stealing as needed.

methods.name: iterate
methods.description: Iterates over the tree in ascending or descending order within a range.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets a subtree, returning nodes to the freelist.
